item.summary: fix(cua-computer): resolve the ESM-only driver SDK during artifact verification (#126120) @trycua/cua-driver ships an exports map with only the import condition, so require-condition resolution throws PATH_NOT_EXPORTED even when the package is installed. Every real Windows/Linux node host therefore failed driver artifact verification with COMPUTER_DRIVER_PACKAGE_MISSING despite a correct install. Fall back to import-condition resolution before concluding the package is missing; the platform packages keep resolving through require. Found during a live CUA node bring-up on an Ubuntu guest; the regression test exercises real installed-package resolution on Linux/Windows CI.
